reconstruction.scope: Specific pictured surviving West Mebon: three distinct east-wall gateways (one lower broken crown), capped perforated east wall, mapped narrow east-to-central stone causeway and low square central platform, sparse low north/west/south ruin fragments. Keep mapped pool open and native reservoir/ground unchanged. No restored complete four-sided temple, museum Vishnu statue, invented roofed central shrine, copied sculpture or photo atlas.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original standard6m Mapzen grid, native rectangular pool/reservoir water, paths and landmass.
